title: Are Animal Years Comparable? Benchmarking Cross-Species Biological Age Equivalence Across Mammals
domain: comparative biology / geroscience / life-history evolution / computational biology
summary: A multi-axis benchmark of cross-species age equivalence. Life-history, independent demographic and 945 held-out homologous-event tests are complete; event-rich leave-one-Timepoint-out translation is substantially more accurate overall but remains species- and stage-dependent. Pilot 3 adds molecular/epigenetic age as an independent measurement family.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided run with live literature/novelty audit and public-web fallback for literature stages
